metadata.name: staking_protocol
metadata.description: VCoin Staking Protocol with Tier System and veVCoin Minting

instructions.name: close_voter
docs: Closes an empty voter account and refunds its rent.

instructions.name: configure_governance
docs: Wires the registrar to its Realms realm as voter-weight plugin (one-shot).

accounts.name: slash_destination
docs: DAO treasury token account that receives slashed VCoin.

instructions.name: create_registrar
docs: Creates the registrar and VCoin vault. Upgrade authority only.

accounts.name: vcoin_mint
docs: Must be the vcoin-token program's mint PDA (checked in the handler) and pass
`validate_vcoin_mint` (no hook, fee, freeze authority or permanent delegate).

accounts.name: vevcoin_mint
docs: Must be the vevcoin-token program's mint PDA (checked in the handler).

instructions.name: create_voter
docs: Creates the caller's voter account.

instructions.name: deactivate_expired
docs: Marks an expired deposit inactive so it stops counting toward the max voter weight.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Locks VCoin into deposit slot `index` for at least `lock_secs` seconds.

accounts.name: owner_vevcoin
docs: The owner's canonical veVCoin ATA: receipts live in exactly one account per owner, so
a slash can always burn them (anyone can recreate the ATA).

instructions.name: extend_lock
docs: Moves a deposit's lock end to `now + lock_secs` (must be later than today's end).

instructions.name: propose_slash
docs: Opens a slash of `amount` against a voter (authority = the DAO). Freezes the
voter's withdrawals; executable by anyone after 48h, void 7 days later.

instructions.name: set_guardian
docs: Sets or clears the emergency guardian (may pause, never unpause).

instructions.name: update_voter_weight_record
docs: Writes the voter's weight for one Realms action (valid for the current slot).

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Withdraws unlocked VCoin from deposit slot `index`.

accounts.name: owner_vevcoin
docs: The owner's canonical veVCoin ATA: receipts live in exactly one account per owner, so
a slash can always burn them (anyone can recreate the ATA).

types.name: AdminState
docs: Authority with a two-step, time-locked transfer, plus an optional emergency guardian.
`propose` (current authority) → wait [`AUTHORITY_TRANSFER_DELAY`] → `accept`
(new authority). The current authority can `cancel` at any time before acceptance.
After launch the authority is a Realms governance PDA, which needs a vote and a hold-up
(days) to act. The `guardian` (e.g. a council multisig or a zero-hold-up council
governance) exists so an emergency stop is possible within minutes: it may **pause**
(never unpause) and use program-specific stop actions such as vetoing a rewards root.
It cannot move funds, change parameters or keep the protocol paused against the
authority, which can unpause and replace it.

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: `Pubkey::default()` when no transfer is pending.

fields.name: pending_since
docs: Unix time the pending transfer was proposed (0 when none).

fields.name: guardian
docs: Emergency guardian (`Pubkey::default()` = none).

types.name: DepositEntry
docs: One locked deposit.

fields.name: is_active
docs: Counted in `Registrar::active_locked` (the base of the max voter weight). Cleared by
`deactivate_expired` or a withdrawal once the lock has ended; set again by a relock.

types.name: GuardianSet
docs: The emergency guardian may pause (never unpause); `Pubkey::default()` = none.

types.name: MaxVoterWeightRecord
docs: Realm-wide maximum voter weight, PDA `["max-voter-weight-record"]`.

types.name: Registrar
docs: Singleton registrar, PDA `["registrar"]`. Owns the VCoin vault and is the only
account the veVCoin program accepts as mint/burn signer.

fields.name: admin
docs: Authority for pause, parameters and slashing. Bootstrapped by the deployer and handed
(24h two-step) to the Realms governance PDA after launch, so every change is a DAO vote.

fields.name: governance_program_id
docs: Realms (SPL Governance) program and realm this registrar serves as voter-weight plugin.

fields.name: realm_governing_token_mint
docs: The realm's community governing-token mint (the mint Realms votes are cast for).

fields.name: slash_destination
docs: Where slashed VCoin goes (DAO treasury token account).

fields.name: min_vote_score
docs: 5A composite score (0..=10000) required to vote / to create proposals.

fields.name: total_locked
docs: Sum of all deposits (receipt supply upper bound; drives MaxVoterWeightRecord).

fields.name: active_locked
docs: Principal in deposits not yet deactivated after their lock ended. The max voter weight
is computed from this, so abandoned expired deposits cannot inflate it forever and
make percentage thresholds unreachable.

types.name: SlashRequest
docs: A DAO-approved slash of one voter's locked deposits, PDA
`["slash", voter, nonce]`. Executable by anyone in `[executable_at, expires_at)`;
the voter's withdrawals are frozen while it exists. Closed (rent to `rent_payer`) when
cancelled, executed or expired.

fields.name: amount
docs: Requested amount; execution takes `min(amount, deposits)`.

fields.name: reason_hash
docs: Hash of the off-chain evidence / DAO proposal text.

types.name: Voter
docs: Per-owner deposits, PDA `["voter", owner]`.

fields.name: pending_slashes
docs: Open slash requests against this voter; withdrawals are frozen while > 0.

types.name: VoterWeightAction
docs: Realms action a voter-weight record is valid for (order is part of the wire format).

types.name: VoterWeightRecord
docs: Per-owner voter weight, PDA `["voter-weight-record", owner]`. Rewritten by
`update_voter_weight_record` in the same transaction as the Realms action
(`voter_weight_expiry = current slot`).

types.name: WeightParams
docs: Voting-weight parameters (fixed point, [`FACTOR_SCALE`] = 1.0×).

constants.name: MIN_LOCK_SECS
docs: Lock bounds (seconds).

constants.name: REGISTRAR_SEED
docs: Registrar PDA seed (must match `vevcoin_token::constants::STAKING_REGISTRAR_SEED`).

constants.name: SLASH_SEED
docs: Slashing: DAO-proposed, executable after a 48h appeal window, void after 7 more days.

constants.name: VAULT_SEED
docs: VCoin vault PDA seed (token account owned by the registrar).

constants.name: VOTER_SEED
docs: Per-owner voter PDA seed: `["voter", owner]`.

constants.name: VOTER_WEIGHT_RECORD_SEED
docs: Realms voter-weight records written by this plugin.
